reuse.why: Builds on the existing pre-link guard and shared linkBankSyncAccount, but writes its own unlink field-clearing instead of extracting and sharing the one in unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: releaseAccountLinks repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block field for field, and the release call is written twice in linkBankSyncAccount's two branches; the flag/ids plumbing is repeated in all six linkers.

placement.why: Detection stays in the pre-link guard and the release happens in the shared link sequence in accounts/app.ts, which fits the layering, though the guard named assertBankAccountNotLinked now returns ids to release, blurring check and action.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing and the release; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: A future change to what 'unlinked' means must be made in both unlinkAccount and releaseAccountLinks, and the assert-that-returns-ids naming plus threading two values through six linkers is awkward to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: releaseAccountLinks in accounts/app.ts re-implements the local unlink of unlinkAccount (same db.updateAccount fields) instead of sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: releaseAccountLinks copies unlinkAccount's field-clearing db.updateAccount under a new name and wrapped in a loop, presented as a separate 'release' concept rather than shared with unlinkAccount.
